exposure: surgical treatment (dilatation and evacuation, hysteroscopic resection, laparoscopic and laparotomic approaches)
medical interventions for cesarean scar pregnancies
surgical interventions for cesarean scar pregnancies
cohort: 48 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy
finding: Surgical intervention for cesarean scar pregnancy had a higher success rate (96.6%) and lower complication rate compared to medical treatment (33% success, higher complication rate).
